headline: Steady growth continues as occupancy softens
summary_short: Q2 2026 revenue rose 8.1% y/y to $224.4M and net income climbed 5.8% to $52.9M, but same-store occupancy slipped to 96.0% from 97.8% a year ago as tenant vacancies offset new leasing at double-digit rent spreads.
summary_long: Revenue growth came from new leases/renewals (+$8.8M same-store lease income) and Q2 acquisitions (7 buildings, $307.7M), partly offset by tenant vacancies. Same-store NOI rose 2.2% on a GAAP basis (+3.4% Same Store Cash NOI per the earnings release) as revenue growth outpaced a same-store opex increase led by real estate taxes and repairs. Net income grew 5.8% y/y despite $3.9M higher interest expense tied to the 2025 unsecured notes issuance, partly offset by a larger gain on property sales. Same-store occupancy fell to 96.0% from 97.8%. Post-quarter, STAG amended and extended roughly $1.19B of unsecured term loans and its credit facility, trimming spreads 5bp and pushing maturities out to 2028-2032. No 2026 guidance was reissued in the release.

drivers.explanation: New leases and renewals added ~$8.8M same-store lease income; Q2 acquisitions (7 buildings, $307.7M) added further revenue, partly offset by tenant vacancies.
Same-store NOI rose 2.2% as revenue growth outpaced a same-store opex increase led by real estate taxes, repairs and maintenance; acquisitions added incremental NOI on top.
NOI growth outweighed a $3.9M rise in interest expense tied to the 2025 unsecured notes issuance and higher D&A; a larger gain on property sales added further upside.
Net income to common stockholders grew 5.8% while diluted weighted-average shares rose only 2.4% (ATM issuance), so per-share growth outpaced share-count dilution.
Same-store occupancy fell as base rent lost to tenant vacancies (~$3.3M) outweighed new leasing, even as re-leasing spreads stayed strongly positive.
CEO Bill Crooker called the quarter "sustained execution across our platform, supported by stabilizing industrial fundamentals"; the release reissued no 2026 guidance.
